title: skeleton template variables
description: Values for templates/skeleton.md.j2 and templates/skeleton.html.j2. Field names match content/02-output-contract.xml; `description` on each property is the question put to the author.

suite_id.title: Suite id
suite_id.description: What kebab-case id names this starter suite, prefixed ffsb- (e.g. ffsb-orders-api)?

suite_owner.title: Suite owner
suite_owner.description: Who is accountable for the whole suite, as role:handle (e.g. arch:alice)? Not a team alias.

launch_date.title: Launch date
launch_date.description: On which date does the suite first run in CI, as YYYY-MM-DD? The four weekly reviews are dated from it.

cadence_after_week_four.title: Cadence after week four
cadence_after_week_four.description: After the four weekly reviews, how often is the suite reviewed — monthly or quarterly?

layers.title: Layers
layers.description: Which layers or module groups does the architecture declare, outermost to innermost (e.g. http, application, domain, infrastructure)?

allowed_edges.title: Allowed edges
allowed_edges.description: Which dependency directions are allowed between those layers, as from->to pairs (e.g. http->application, application->domain)?

week1_date.title: Week 1 review date
week1_date.description: On which date is the first weekly review, seven days after launch, as YYYY-MM-DD?

reviewer.title: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Who runs the first weekly review, as role:handle?

function_id.title: Function id
function_id.description: What kebab-case id names this fitness function (e.g. checkout-p95)?

category.title: Category
category.description: Which of the five bootstrap categories does this function cover — performance, deployability, dependency, complexity or contract?

tool_name.title: Tool
tool_name.description: Which tool runs it (k6, Gatling, Locust, ArchUnit, NetArchTest, dependency-cruiser, import-linter, radon, lizard, SonarQube, Pact, oasdiff, buf)?

command.title: Command
command.description: What exact command does CI run for this function, verbatim?

threshold_operator.title: Threshold operator
threshold_operator.description: How does the measured value compare to the threshold to pass — <, <=, >, >= or ==?

threshold_value.title: Threshold value
threshold_value.description: What numeric limit must the measured value satisfy?

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: What unit is the threshold in (ms, minutes, violations, new violations, breaking changes)? Deployability is always minutes.

baseline_value.title: Baseline value
baseline_value.description: What did the command measure on main before launch?

baseline_date.title: Baseline date
baseline_date.description: On which date was the baseline measured, as YYYY-MM-DD?

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Is the function informational, ratchet (fail only when worse than baseline) or blocking? Blocking only after five green runs and a review.

runs_on.title: Runs on
runs_on.description: Where does it run — every pull_request, post_merge, or nightly? Performance is post_merge or nightly; dependency is pull_request.

function_owner.title: Function owner
function_owner.description: Who is accountable for this function, as role:handle?
